g.text: GitHub phase labels and closure reason stay separate from Codex execution; labels never prove a native turn is running.
Interrupted or unknown work: preserve native history, reconcile, then explicitly continue. Never silently replay.
Improvement proposals must fit the project vision. New goals or access require an owner decision.
Optional recipe: Local Build · Cloud Review, when the selected harness supports and qualifies those model choices.
Defence findings remain private where required; publication and production recovery need their own authority.
